name: What are the common signs of a problem with my gas line connected to the water heater?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a problem with my gas line connected to the water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a gas line issue include a distinct sulfur or rotten egg smell, which indicates a gas leak. Other indicators can be a hissing sound near the gas line, discolored or dead vegetation near outdoor gas lines, or a yellow or orange flame on gas appliances instead of a steady blue one. If you notice any of these, it's crucial to contact a qualified plumber immediately to ensure safety and prevent further damage. Do not attempt to fix a gas leak yourself.
